project_type: Monorepo with React/Vite/Tailwind web app and Expo/React Native mobile app
verification_instructions: 1. Run `bun run build` in apps/web to verify build passes. 2. Run `bun run lint` in apps/web to verify lint passes. 3. For mobile, run `bunx expo lint` in apps/mobile.
setup_instructions: 1. `bun install` in apps/web. 2. `bun install` in apps/mobile.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. No Docker needed for this project.
contribution_requirements: Maintain Netflix-style dark theme aesthetic. Keep all existing functionality intact.
key_patterns: Web uses Tailwind CSS with custom theme colors (bg-background, text-muted-foreground, etc). Mobile uses React Native StyleSheet with colors from theme.js. Components are in src/components/ directories. Pages are in src/app/ directories. PlayerBox renders VideoPlayer when isPlaying=true. DetailHero shows backdrop_url as full-width background image with gradient overlays.
directory_structure: apps/web/src/components/ - reusable UI components, apps/web/src/app/ - page components with routing, apps/mobile/src/components/ - RN UI components, apps/mobile/src/app/ - Expo Router pages
